title: In Korea, the Ambulance Is Free

slides.headline: One number: **119**
slides.body: Fire, rescue and ambulance all answer the same three digits. Say where you are, and a crew is on the way.

slides.headline: The ride costs **₩0**
slides.body: Taxes pay for it. No ambulance bill arrives later, rich or poor, Korean or visitor.

slides.headline: The crew are **firefighters**
slides.body: 119 ambulances belong to the fire service. The paramedics on board are fire officers, and many are trained nurses.

slides.headline: Traffic **gets out of the way**
slides.body: Drivers must pull aside for a 119 truck or ambulance. Blocking one can cost up to ₩2 million (about $1,400).

slides.headline: Free gets **misused**
slides.body: Some call it for a cold, a toothache or a ride home. Crews can refuse cases that are not emergencies.

slides.headline: The ride is free. **The ER is not.**
slides.body: Hospital care is billed through health insurance. Show up with something minor, and you pay more of it.

slides.headline: How often a 119 ambulance **heads out**
slides.body: 3.29 million calls in 2025, about 9,000 a day.

slides.headline: Elsewhere a bill. **Here, a phone call.**
slides.body: In the US one ground ambulance trip averaged over $1,000 in 2021. Here, nobody stops to ask what it will cost.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: An ambulance's warm emergency lights glowing on a wet city street at night, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, you call 119 and the ambulance ride costs nothing.

Taxes pay for it, and firefighters drive it.

What does an ambulance cost where you live?
reply: One more: moving between hospitals is not a 119 job. For that you book a private ambulance, and it charges by distance. Would free make you call sooner?
fact_check: 1·3장: 119 구급대 이송은 세금으로 운영, 이용료 없음. 국적 무관.
4장: 119 구급대는 소방 소속, 구급대원은 소방공무원(응급구조사·간호사 자격자 다수).
5장: 소방기본법 제21조 소방자동차 우선 통행, 제56조 방해 시 200만원 이하 과태료(상한). $1,400 환산.
6장: 119구조·구급법 제13조, 시행령 제20조 — 단순 치통·감기·만성질환 검진 이송 등 비응급은 출동·이송 거절 가능. 2025년 미이송 130만 건.
7장: 응급실 진료비는 건강보험 적용 본인부담, 비응급·경증은 응급의료관리료 등 본인부담 커짐.
9장: Health Care Cost Institute — 미국 지상 구급차 평균 가격 2021년 $1,093.
댓글: 병원 간 비응급 이송은 119 거절 대상(시행령 제20조), 민간 구급차는 거리 기준 요금.
